Tells you when a background check found messages you have not read yet. GrapMail has no push service, so these come from the app asking the server itself, when the system wakes it.
Tells you the moment something happens to your account: a sign-in from a new device, a password change, a trusted-device change. These are never silenced by quiet hours.
